description: This file provides instructions and commands to verify the presence of basic firewall rulesets using nftables or iptables, specifically checking for chains or markers related to input, forward, and output chains.

methods.name: Create R alias
methods.description: Defines an alias R to remotely execute commands, defaulting to an environment variable CRAM_REMOTE_COMMAND.

methods.name: Check fw4 nftables chains
methods.description: Checks for the presence of nftables chains for input, forward, and output to verify firewall ruleset presence.

methods.name: Fallback legacy iptables presence
methods.description: Checks for iptables rules if nftables are not available, ensuring backward compatibility.
